location_description: Hialeah ( HY-ə-LEE-ə; American Spanish: [haʝaˈli.a]) is a city in Miami-Dade County, Florida. With a population of 223,109 as of the 2020 census, Hialeah is the sixth-largest city in Florida. It is the second largest city by population in the Miami metropolitan area, which was home to an estimated 6,198,782 people at the 2018 census.
